_comment: Pinned upstream research dependencies for AMIS. Licenses and commit SHAs were read from shallow clones on 2026-11-26. Star counts are popularity figures supplied by the AMIS owner, not verified, and say nothing about profitability.

projects.name: LEAN
projects.notes: Large .NET engine. Reviewed and pinned but not wired into AMIS runtime; use it as an external engine or for reference.

projects.name: Backtrader
projects.notes: Copyleft. Not copied into this repo. Last upstream commit is April 2023.

projects.name: TA-Lib (Python wrapper)
projects.language: Python wrapper over a C library
projects.notes: Needs the native TA-Lib C library, or a wheel that bundles it.

projects.name: VectorBT
projects.notes: Commons Clause forbids selling the software or a service whose value derives substantially from it. Fine for private research.

projects.name: backtesting.py
projects.notes: AGPL-3.0, which extends to network use. Keep it out of any hosted AMIS service unless you accept those terms.
